recommended_method: One Meshy 7.1 multiview draft through fal, then local mechanical separation/cleanup and custom Three.js rig

recipe.texture_prompt: Match the accepted graphite, steel-blue and brushed-titanium lift. Retain functional safety markings and restrained Pegasoft #147DFF, #7BCBFF and #B9E7FF accents. Natural materials, no warm decorative spill. No new logos, lettering, labels, people or watermarks; branding will be applied separately.

remaining_plates_use: Rig/component/working-pose comparison only; avoid mixing different poses in the base-mesh request. No overhead/underside inputs. Accepted quarters remain available for local review.
output: Textured GLB/PBR draft; topology and part separability require inspection. Image inputs guide geometry; texture_prompt guides materials only.

pricing.limit: Generation rate, not total production cost. Recheck before submission; no automatic additional jobs.

runtime.route: Local Node/Three.js named rigid meshes, constrained joints and GLB inspection/export; no installs or dependency edits in this review.

rig.label: Chassis and wheels
rig.controls: Ground translation; wheel rotation from travel
rig.purpose: Keep the accepted body rigid; rotate wheels around their axle centers.

rig.label: Boom and telescoping sections
rig.purpose: Separate rigid sections; preserve overlap and the original hinge.

rig.label: Hydraulic linkage
rig.purpose: Follow linkage endpoints from the boom pose; keep rams connected.

rig.label: Spreader and loaded settling
rig.controls: Balanced pose; settling joint offset; attachment state
rig.purpose: Keep the container rigidly attached. Fit the brief damped swing from continuous playback; leave axis, amplitude and timing unset until calibration.

rig.label: Container support and release
rig.purpose: Use a clearly labeled proxy only in lift-rig diagnostics until the separate container is approved. Support precedes release.

rig.label: Camera and timeline
rig.controls: Orbit/zoom; camera pivot; reversible phase scrub
rig.purpose: Keep camera transforms separate from joint motion; verify normal playback, pause/resume and reverse.

settling_driver_proposal: Reference-fitted deterministic damped joint offset over lift-off phase, sampled with scroll progress. Confirm from playback/live scroll whether a time response is required; revise driver before final motion review if the source continues to settle at fixed scroll.
production_steps: Generate exactly one approved mesh draft
Inspect silhouette, wheel/cab/boom identity, materials and topology
Preserve the approved model and exact carbon recipe. Derive a separate articulated output without changing the locked static baseline.
Separate rigid parts and locally reconstruct limited fused/sliding geometry while preserving accepted identity
Apply exact external PEGASOFT Solutions lettering; review carbon and porcelain
Present orbit, zoom, part controls and comparison poses for final interactive-model approval
Calibrate and render the approved sequence; obtain final motion review
stop_conditions: Material identity or mechanical geometry differs substantially
Part separation would require a substantial rebuild
Endpoint, pricing or recipe changes from approved scope

alternative.method: Locally authored articulated geometry from accepted views
alternative.tradeoff: Direct control of all parts; more modeling/material work and fidelity still requires review
alternative.status: Alternative for explicit selection; not executed

approval_scope: Approved method, four existing inputs and exact recipe for one mesh draft. Obtain interactive draft approval before cleanup/rigging; final model and motion approvals remain separate.
next_gate: Physical cab, wheel and proxy-contact visual acceptance; hold container concept until this derivative passes
future_material_rule: Use agreed #11151B for painted carbon/graphite; preserve accepted existing assets and separate blue/metal/rubber/glass roles. Review exact physical finishes by role.
next_action: Review closed wheel entities, clockwise forward/counterclockwise reverse scroll, physical cab and proxy contact through lift/camera/settling. Hold container gate.
